title: Authority Exhaustion and Emergency Fallback
summary: Work through Authority Exhaustion and Emergency Fallback.

blocks.md: This lesson follows **Authority Exhaustion and Emergency Fallback** in *Safety Enforcement* (Vol IV).

blocks.source: Vol IV, Safety Enforcement, § Authority Exhaustion and Emergency Fallback
blocks.md: A loaded arm descending toward the packing station must counter gravity before any torque remains to slow its motion. **Actuator saturation** occurs when requested effort reaches the electrical, mechanical, or thermal limits of the physical body, which can cause downstream integral controllers to accumulate windup. The actuator cannot deliver the corrective control action CertifiedControlAction at its commanded magnitude in any of several cases. Motor phase currents may hit inverter current-chopping limits (InverterCurrentLimit). The DC bus may sag under inductive switching transients (PowerRailInductance\,dConductorCurrent/dTimeInstant).

blocks.prompt: Think first: In two or three sentences, explain why Net braking authority matters for the system this section describes.
blocks.md: Compare your answer with the book's claim: Available deceleration is net of gravity and bias in the worst direction, and integrator unwinding and saturation spend it before the stop begins.

questions.q: The section **Authority Exhaustion and Emergency Fallback** develops one of the chapter's claims. Which one?
options: When contact is the task the kinetic barrier admits only zero speed, so an energy-tank passivity barrier and a separately qualified force channel replace clearance as the margin.
Available deceleration is net of gravity and bias in the worst direction, and integrator unwinding and saturation spend it before the stop begins.
The feedback tracker guarantees a worst-case tracking tube only inside its qualified envelope, so the enforcer insets every clearance by it and watches the premises that keep it true.

The stopping envelope is the set of states from which the resident stop, after every worst-case delay, halts before the obstacle with localization, protective, and tracking margins intact, and its seven priced rows run as a per-tick speed governor.
